course_name: Let's Discover More English - 8th Year Basic Education

source.textbook: Let's Discover More English - 8th Year Basic Education Teacher's Book
source.publisher: Republic of Tunisia, Ministry of Education, National Pedagogic Centre

overview.approach: Story-driven with communicative language teaching methodology
pedagogical_approach: Learning as discovery: Students discover more about English and themselves
Learner-centered: Students at the core of the teaching-learning process
Skills integration: Reading, writing, listening, and speaking practiced together
Project-based learning: Incorporated as major component
Process-oriented: Focus on both product and learning processes
Self-evaluation: Built-in assessment at end of each module
lesson_structure: Let's Get Ready: Activate prior knowledge and set objectives
Let's Discover: Engage in discovering new content
Let's Communicate: Reinvest learning to produce oral/written texts

modules.module_name: Tell Me About Yourself and Your Plans
modules.story_context: Tunisian teenager Imene invited to London by English family (the Browns)

assessment: Ability to read and understand explicitly stated information
Ability to write a few lines to introduce people in a photo

lessons.lesson_title: A letter from an English friend

key_activities: Use diary notes to write future sentences
assessment: Ability to read a letter for gist
Ability to recognize sender and receiver
Ability to identify features of an informal letter

grammar_points: NEW: Expressing future ability (will be able to + base form)
Sequential adverbs (first, then, next, after that, finally)
key_structures: will be able to + base form
key_activities: Listen to family conversation about permission

grammar_points: Review: Present progressive for future arrangements
